verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents AI drafting answers to inbound security questionnaires from the customer's own controls or knowledge base. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability. Comply AI in vendor risk management extracts answers from vendors' documents, which is the reverse direction (assessing third parties). The Trust Center lets prospects self-serve documents but does not draft questionnaire responses.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
